location: West-rim homestead, wolf pen and ravine stair
time: World W2 at dusk; personal order 1
scene_purpose: Establish authored normality, the wolf bond, fire geography and small unexplained details.
entry_state: The protagonist believes the private world is fully known and secure.
objective: Finish chores, seat the wolf and descend before night.
reason_objective_matters: The routine defines what home means and proves which changes he normally controls.
obstacle: An incomplete red wool line and unexpected glow create low-level uncertainty.
opposing_agent: Unexplained evidence rather than a person.
tactics: Inspect briefly, rationalise the wool as an old marker and continue the routine.
information_revealed: No other player should have altered the world; the wolf waits when seated; timber passes above lava at a visible gap.
information_withheld: The wool was placed by his travelling self and the portal has just been built below.
visual_event: The wolf sits beside the intact house as purple light pulses under the ravine lip.
turn: The portal sound is unmistakable and new.
outcome: He leaves the wolf and descends.
new_question: What is producing a portal sound in the known-empty cave?
story_value: Bond, authorship and geography earn the threshold.
production_requirements: Intact homestead state, controllable wolf seating, lava glimpse and repeatable descent angle.

time: World W2 at dusk; personal order 2
scene_purpose: Pose the title mystery and make entry consequential.
entry_state: He expects an environmental oddity, not deliberate construction.
reason_objective_matters: A constructed object in a private world challenges his most reliable knowledge.
obstacle: The frame is complete, lit and made from resources he did not place here.
opposing_agent: The portal and the protagonist’s uncertainty.
tactics: Check inventory, chest, block faces, asymmetrical footing and reversed torch.
information_revealed: The frame is deliberate and contains familiar but non-exclusive habits.
information_withheld: The builder is his later self and the route leads to World W4.
emotional_progression: Unease to chosen fear and curiosity.
visual_event: His hand traces the odd cobblestone base before entering the purple plane.
turn: No ordinary explanation survives, so he steps through.
outcome: He reaches the burned version of the same cave exit.
exit_state: He has surrendered temporal certainty by choice.
new_question: When and where has the portal taken him?
story_value: Inciting agency and fair mystery evidence.
production_requirements: Portal hero set, matched frame details and a controlled intact-to-burned transition.

time: World W4 at dawn; personal order 3
scene_purpose: Convert temporal mystery into personal loss while proving spatial continuity.
entry_state: He has arrived somewhere impossible but still expects a route home.
objective: Reach the house and find the wolf.
reason_objective_matters: The wolf is the only living relationship attached to the threatened home.
obstacle: Familiar paths are damaged, the house is burned and the pen is empty.
opposing_agent: Aftermath, incomplete evidence and time displacement.
tactics: Match landmarks, inspect block scars and search the pen without assuming a body exists.
information_revealed: The ravine and house are the same location after one destructive event.
information_withheld: The wolf has already escaped with his later self; the exact cause and date remain unknown.
visual_event: An intact stone drain leads past an open empty pen beneath the collapsed roof.
turn: Movement on the eastern ridge suggests another survivor or culprit.
outcome: He abandons the search pattern and pursues.
exit_state: Loss now has an apparent agent.
new_question: Who is the ridge figure, and what happened to the wolf?
story_value: Spatial proof, emotional stake and pursuit propulsion.
production_requirements: Burned-state rebuild, matched camera positions, empty pen without false death evidence.

location: Eastern ridge and surviving portal cave
time: World W4 at dawn; personal order 4
scene_purpose: Seed the self-identity clue and motivate the second transit.
entry_state: He believes the figure may explain or have caused the ruin.
objective: Catch the figure, then use the portal if pursuit fails.
reason_objective_matters: Without an answer, the wolf’s absence appears final.
obstacle: The ridge conceals the lower path and the figure stays beyond identification distance.
opposing_agent: The later protagonist deliberately managing what his earlier self sees.
tactics: Sprint along the upper path, track a newly placed torch, then return to the only functioning route.
information_revealed: The figure knows the same two-crouch orientation habit and left-wall placement.
information_withheld: The wolf is below the ridge and the figure is the protagonist after rescue.
visual_event: The silhouette crouches twice, places a torch and vanishes beyond the crest.
turn: A second crossing ejects him in front of bare rock with no portal frame.
outcome: He is stranded before the construction event.
exit_state: A possible retry becomes a past-state trap.
new_question: Can he warn his younger self without erasing the route home?
story_value: Active mystery pursuit and temporal reversal.
production_requirements: Distant duplicate plate, terrain occlusion and transient frame-less exit effect.

location: Bare north-wall cave and ravine overlook
time: World W1 shortly before discovery; personal order 5
scene_purpose: Prove past placement and establish the double-self constraint.
entry_state: He hopes he has returned to a correctable earlier state.
objective: Date the world and locate an exit.
reason_objective_matters: He needs to know whether action can prevent the fire.
obstacle: The frame is absent and approaching sounds make open movement risky.
opposing_agent: The younger protagonist’s ordinary route and the older self’s fear of contact.
tactics: Compare missing blocks, inspect undamaged supports and observe from cover.
information_revealed: This is the same world shortly before his discovery; the younger self and wolf are alive above.
information_withheld: The older self has not yet accepted that he built the portal or caused the fire.
visual_event: Bare wall occupies the exact outline of the remembered portal while the younger avatar crosses above.
turn: The wolf sits beside the younger self, within sight but not safely reachable unseen.
outcome: He chooses concealment and begins planning an indirect warning.
new_question: What warning can help without making the younger self avoid the portal?
story_value: Rules out copies and activates internal opposition.
production_requirements: Bare cave state, precise portal outline reference and separated-avatar blocking.

location: Homestead perimeter, supply barrel and eastern drain
time: World W1 shortly before discovery; personal order 6
pov: Close older protagonist with younger self kept at distance
scene_purpose: Make intervention, memory and concealment one causal action.
entry_state: He wants to move the wolf but fears changing the younger self’s decision.
objective: Leave a usable warning without revealing another human presence.
reason_objective_matters: He believes the portal journey may be the only source of successful foreknowledge.
obstacle: The younger self stays nearby and an explicit sign would expose outside agency.
opposing_agent: The approaching younger self and the protagonist’s own protective secrecy.
tactics: Take three local red wool blocks, start a route towards the drain and stop before forming an arrowhead.
information_revealed: He created the unexplained strip shown in the opening.
information_withheld: Whether direct honesty would have produced a better response remains unknowable.
visual_event: The fourth wool block remains in hand as approaching footsteps force him behind the wall.
turn: The incomplete pattern exactly matches his memory.
outcome: He accepts that intervention can be part of established history.
exit_state: Hope of simple warning becomes responsibility for causality.
new_question: If he made this clue, did he also make the portal?
story_value: First decisive proof of the self-consistent model.
production_requirements: Exterior barrel continuity, three-block pattern and clear drain direction without text exposition.

time: World W1 approaching dusk; personal order 7
scene_purpose: Turn the builder inference into a voluntary structural commitment.
entry_state: He is stranded with an ambiguous warning and little time.
objective: Find a way to ensure his younger self gains useful knowledge.
reason_objective_matters: Without the journey, he has no evidence that anyone reaches the fire with a rescue plan.
obstacle: No frame or exit exists, and direct confrontation may prevent entry.
opposing_agent: The younger self’s countdown and the protagonist’s need for control.
tactics: Compare the remembered footing with the lava shelf, inventory tools and the frame outline.
information_revealed: Local lava can supply ordinary obsidian; the remembered irregularities are reproducible actions.
information_withheld: The first cause of the temporal property remains unknown.
visual_event: He places a temporary outline where the impossible frame stood.
turn: He chooses to become its builder rather than wait for history to compel him.
outcome: The title mystery has an intended answer but not yet a completed action.
exit_state: Can he finish without creating the ruin he saw?
setup_or_payoff: Major agency decision and ending preparation.
story_value: Readable resource plan, countdown sight line and no invented material appearance.

location: Lava shelf and north-wall portal cave
time: World W1 into W2; personal order 8
scene_purpose: Pay off construction clues while planting the ordinary destruction chain.
entry_state: He has committed but lacks portal materials.
objective: Mine, assemble and light the frame before the younger self descends.
reason_objective_matters: The foreknowledge-producing entry depends on physical completion.
obstacle: Awkward lava access, limited time and the need to reach the upper frame encourage temporary staging.
opposing_agent: Terrain, resources and the approaching younger self.
tactics: Cool and mine local obsidian, use spruce staging, copy the asymmetrical footing and place the reversed torch.
information_revealed: The protagonist physically creates every portal clue from practical decisions.
information_withheld: The staging’s precise ignition behaviour and the approaching fire remain unseen.
emotional_progression: Purposeful control to unease at the exact match.
visual_event: Water leaves an irregular cobblestone foot; the lit frame repeats the opening composition from behind.
turn: The solved mystery and the hazardous timber connection are the same construction act.
outcome: The portal waits for the younger self while the older self hides.
exit_state: Achievement now contains an unrecognised cost.
new_question: Will he interrupt the entry when he sees it from the other side?
story_value: Mystery resolution, Minecraft causality and latent reversal.
production_requirements: Local obsidian montage, exact frame continuity and candidate staging geometry reserved for testing.

location: Portal concealment ledge and ravine stair
time: World W2 at dusk; personal order 9
scene_purpose: Reframe the opening and make silence a consequential choice.
entry_state: The portal is complete and the younger self is approaching.
objective: Ensure entry occurs without being discovered.
reason_objective_matters: He believes the journey is necessary for the later rescue chance.
obstacle: He can still speak, appear, break the frame or let the event proceed.
opposing_agent: The younger self’s hesitation and the older self’s fear of losing foreknowledge.
tactics: Remain concealed, watch the inspection and refuse the impulse to warn.
information_revealed: The unknown builder witnessed the opening and chose not to identify himself.
information_withheld: The extent of the fire and wolf’s exact danger remain unknown.
visual_event: The opening blocking repeats from the opposite side; an ember then appears along the staging.
turn: Smoke rises immediately after the younger self crosses.
outcome: The older self races towards the homestead instead of entering again.
exit_state: The causal loop becomes an active survival crisis.
new_question: Can foreknowledge save both the house and the wolf?
production_requirements: Eyeline match, concealed-camera angle, initial fire stage and no required same-frame close duplicate.

time: World W3 at night; personal order 10
scene_purpose: Expose the ordinary cause and make resource allocation irreversible.
entry_state: He knows the ruin but still believes preparation can preserve the house.
objective: Break the fire route and extinguish every front.
reason_objective_matters: The house contains his work, supplies and identity as an author.
obstacle: Fire has reached separated supports; one water source must be moved rather than covering all fronts.
opposing_agent: Spreading fire enabled by his staging and his attachment to structural completeness.
tactics: Break stair blocks, move water across the roof and trace the flame down to the spruce connection.
information_revealed: His hurried portal construction supplied the fire bridge.
information_withheld: The wolf’s survival remains possible until its cry redirects attention.
emotional_progression: Determination to causal guilt and panic.
visual_event: A roof section falls while the water runs harmlessly past another burning front.
turn: The wolf cries from behind the closed pen and the route begins to close.
outcome: He stops treating the whole structure as a winnable objective.
exit_state: Saving both has become physically incredible.
new_question: Which objective will receive the water and remaining seconds?
story_value: Ordinary cause confirmation and forced climax choice.
production_requirements: Mechanically tested staged burn, safe reset plan, clear undercroft geography and controlled wolf audio.

location: Eastern stone drain, burning yard and wolf pen
time: World W3 at night; personal order 11
scene_purpose: Resolve the dramatic question through a Minecraft-backed value choice.
entry_state: The house still has salvageable blocks while the wolf is trapped.
objective: Reach, release and lead the wolf out.
reason_objective_matters: Delay risks a living companion for a recoverable structure.
obstacle: The exposed yard burns and the current water placement protects roof blocks elsewhere.
opposing_agent: Fire, limited time and the protagonist’s former priority.
tactics: Recover the source, place it through the stone drain, cross the wet approach, open the pen and release the seated wolf.
information_revealed: The red marker indicates a viable route and the future image never proved the wolf died.
information_withheld: The ridge concealment and full silhouette loop remain to be completed.
emotional_progression: Grief and urgency to relief without triumph.
visual_event: The wolf stands and follows through the water while the roof burns beyond saving.
turn: He looks back once but does not return to the roof.
outcome: Wolf and protagonist reach the lower eastern path; the ruin remains fixed.
exit_state: Care has replaced structural control as the operative goal.
new_question: How can the wolf be alive without contradicting the empty aftermath?
story_value: Earned climax, relationship change and fair reversal.
production_requirements: Reliable source placement, pen interaction, non-teleporting wolf path and controlled background fire.

time: World W4 at dawn; personal order 12
pov: Older protagonist, wolf and distant earlier self
scene_purpose: Close the figure loop, preserve fair concealment and deliver the transformed final image.
entry_state: The wolf is safe but the earlier self is about to arrive and see the ruin.
objective: Leave while allowing the rescue-producing journey to occur once.
reason_objective_matters: Revealing the wolf may remove the apparent loss that motivated the second crossing.
obstacle: The ridge offers only a brief controlled sight line before the earlier self reaches the portal.
opposing_agent: The arriving younger self and the older self’s morally costly commitment to continuity.
tactics: Keep the wolf below the crest, step into view, crouch twice, place the left-wall torch, wait for pursuit and douse the frame after transit.
information_revealed: The ridge figure was the protagonist; the wolf survived outside the original viewpoint; the events occurred once.
information_withheld: Why this copied portal routes through time remains intentionally open.
emotional_progression: Relief to moral ache and quiet acceptance.
visual_event: Reverse angle reveals the wolf below the silhouette; the final walk reverses the opening separation.
turn: The earlier self crosses into the past and the older self extinguishes the portal.
outcome: He continues into ordinary time with the wolf while the house remains burned.
exit_state: Mystery and relationship resolve; authorship question retains non-essential residue.
new_question: Where did the portal’s temporal pattern first originate?
story_value: Identity confirmation, causal closure and final thematic image.
production_requirements: One controlled duplicate plate, ridge occlusion, portal dousing and dawn lighting continuity.
